_doc: Gold/reference set for evaluating the free-text AI analysis. Each case is a free-text question + its answers, with a human-labeled expected sentiment bucket and the themes a correct analysis should surface. Sentiment is scored by majority bucket (positive/neutral/negative dominates); themes by token overlap with the expected set. Extend with real anonymized data for a stronger eval.
